Maintenance Technician - 2nd Shift
Location: Detroit, MI
This is an on-site position.
Wage: $30 - $38/hr
Type: Full-time

Keep our stamping lines running. Troubleshoot hydraulic, pneumatic and electrical faults.

Requirements
- Journeyman card or 3+ years of industrial maintenance experience
- Ability to read electrical schematics
- Own hand tools
